The temple is distinguished by its simpler artwork and nearby ruins of its mandapa.

meta.title: File:Ornate Lathe-Turned Pillars of Chennakeshava Temple, Belur, Karnataka.jpg
meta.desc: The interior of the Chennakeshava Temple at Belur is renowned for its highly polished, lathe-turned stone pillars. Constructed under Hoysala ruler Vishnuvardhana in the 12th century, the temple combines intricate structural detailing with finely carved ornamental motifs characteristic of Hoysala architecture.
